SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS PO_NO, KEY_2 AS PO_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TR' AND TARGET IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID='KOL3') AND KEY_9 = 'N' GROUP BY DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO ,PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEM_NO ,NVL(PODT.DS_DATE,' ') AS DS_DATE ,POHD.AGENT ,PODT.ITEM_QTY ,PODT.DO_QTY ,PODT.IV_QTY ,PODT.DI_QTY ,PODT.GR_QTY ,PODT.BUYER AS PLANT ,PODT.PO_NO ,PODT.PO_SEQ ,( CASE WHEN PODT.DO_QTY=0 THEN '1' WHEN PODT.DO_QTY != 0 AND PODT.IV_QTY = 0 THEN '2' WHEN PODT.DO_QTY != 0 AND PODT.IV_QTY != 0 AND PODT.DI_QTY = 0 THEN '3' WHEN PODT.DO_QTY != 0 AND PODT.IV_QTY != 0 AND PODT.DI_QTY != 0 THEN '4' ELSE '9' END ) AS ORDER_FLAG ,(SELECT NVL(T.COM_NAME_LOC,' ') FROM ICOMCMPY T WHERE T.COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT ) AS AGENT_NAME ,(SELECT NVL(T.TEL_NO,' ') FROM ICOMCMPY T WHERE T.COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT ) AS AGENT_TEL ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS SYS_DATE ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS SYS_TIME FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMTRXL TRXL WHERE TRXL.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TRXL.KEY_9 = 'N' AND TRXL.TARGET = PODT.BUYER AND TRXL.KEY_1 = PODT.PO_NO AND TRXL.KEY_2 = PODT.PO_SEQ AND TRXL.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND TRXL.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND TRXL.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND PODT.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND POHD.STATUS IN ('C','R') ORDER BY PODT.BUYER, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_9 = 'N' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 ='$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_9 = 'N' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 ='$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
